title: criteria_read_from_their_files_take_the_label_order reads no file
body:
Found by ST0096's catch-up critics (vc, 2026-11-22, refs/bank/vc/st0096/close-H1-* and close-H3-*). Fixed under hv decision 86 in cc's d86c for 3.5.1.

tests/a_thread_is_its_records_files.rs: the arm sorts a literal list with id::label_order and never reads a criterion's file, so removing ingest's sort of the criteria it reads leaves it green. Expected: the arm writes a thread's criteria as files and reads them through ingest, so removing the sort turns it red.
